note: Tiers map to floating aliases, never to dated model IDs. Update this file only when a platform gains or retires a model family.

claude.label: Claude Code
claude.notes: Agent tool accepts family aliases; each alias floats to the newest model of that family. `fable` is used for deep when the host exposes it.

codex.label: Codex CLI
codex.notes: Model names vary by release. Run `keelson models rank <name> <tier>` once, or `keelson models --refresh` with OPENAI_API_KEY to infer from the provider catalogue.

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.notes: OpenCode provides built-in subagents; model identifiers are provider-qualified and project-specific, so Keelson does not guess a tier mapping.

pi.label: Pi coding agent
pi.notes: Pi model selection depends on the configured provider. Keep effort tiers semantic unless the user supplies aliases.

kiro.label: Kiro CLI
kiro.notes: Kiro CLI supports parallel subagents. Model availability can vary by account and release, so aliases are user-configured.

codebuddy.label: CodeBuddy CLI
codebuddy.notes: CodeBuddy exposes an Agent subagent tool and host-specific model aliases. Keelson does not persist release-specific model IDs.
